The title and description are visible at the top. Long references wrap within the modal. The viewport bounds the dialog and lower fields continue in its intended vertical scroll area.

The Arabic title is visible. Exact Arabic digits, XTS and confirmed-period labels fit the dialog; reference identifiers wrap without overlapping labels.
Headings, two currency cards, unavailable notices, financial table, action controls and exception cards are visually readable on the dark background without observed overlap.
